messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert — SEV-2: High packet loss and intermittent reachability for traffic from SFO -> eu-west via provider-3. Impact: hosted API front-door, embeddings ingestion. Initial customer hits ~12 customers. PD: PD12345. Link: https://pd.example/PD12345

pagerduty: Paging sasha (oncall) for PD12345 — escalation 1m ago

sasha (oncall): on it. pulling graphs + BGP dumps now. can someone watch api errors? @raj-support please confirm customer-facing symptom list

raj-support: customers reporting slow API responses and some 5xx spikes, mostly writes/embeddings. triaging tickets, tagging affected customers. collecting request ids.

kevin-net: I see BGP withdraws and flaps from provider-3 towards our egress AS in SFO. packetloss ~25-45% on UDP/TCP to eu path. suspected hw flapping on peer side (transit card). quick snippet from edge router: 
```
sudo vtysh -c 'show bgp neighbors 198.51.100.2 advertised-routes'
BGP neighbor 198.51.100.2 up/down: flapping, last reset 00:02:34
Prefix Rx errors: ...
```

ingrid-sre: confirmed 5xx spike on API front-door at 1978510100 — correlates with kevin's BGP flap windows. latency also increased between SFO front proxies -> eu endpoints.

sasha (oncall): ok, mitigation plan: 1) fail traffic SFO egress to provider-1 (preferred alternate) 2) apply more-specific prepends to withdraw from provider-3 path 3) update incident channel and ping customers if stable. executing step 1 now.

kevin-net: recommend changing local-pref and advertise /24s from SFO to steer away from provider-3 — provider-3 is selectively dropping. Also reduce multipath to avoid hashed flows hitting bad link.

sasha (oncall): executing emergency reroute (internal runbook step 4b). command: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://internal-console/api/v1/egress/reroute -H 'Authorization: Bearer *****' -d '{"scope":"sfo","target":"provider-1","reason":"SEV-2-packetloss-provider-3"}'
```

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Emergency egress change applied for scope=sfo target=provider-1 at 1978510200 (change-id=c-8721)

kevin-net: I also pushed a temporary `community` + local-pref tweak on BGP sessions to deprioritize provider-3 prefixes; monitoring adv/withdraw stability.

ingrid-sre: metrics post-reroute: 1978510300 -> 1978510500: 5xx rate down ~70%, tail latency back to normal for most routes. some customers still see errors due to cached downstream failures (retrying).

nina-product: which customers were hit hardest? need list for comms. @raj-support can you prepare impact matrix: customer, window, requests failed, mitigation applied?

raj-support: collecting, will post CSV in a few mins. rough: 12 customers, two enterprise customers experienced >30% request failures for ~7-12 minutes between 1978509950-1978510100.

sasha (oncall): good. handoff notes for next oncall (ingrid): root cause believed: upstream provider-3 device flapping, causing partial blackholing and BGP route oscillation. mitigation done: emergency egress to provider-1, local-pref adjustments, withdraw more specifics from provider-3. open items: confirm provider-3 fix, remove emergency prepends, prepare customer comms, runbook improvements.

ingrid-sre: taking over. I'll keep monitoring bgp session stability and queue an immediate support ticket with provider-3 NOC (ticket ref: NOC-9982). assigning postmortem owner to @kevin-net + @sasha.

kevin-net: provider-3 NOC acknowledged intermittent hardware fault on PE1 in SFO; they started traffic-engineering to drain the card. They request we keep emergency prepends for 30m to avoid flip-flop.

sasha (oncall): acknowledged. I'll schedule automated rollback after 30m if no further signs. also creating incident page: https://incidents.example/INC-2026-317 with timeline.

deploy-bot: :information_source: Incident document created INC-2026-317 at 1978510405 by sasha

incident-bot: Reminder: update PD status and set severity to SEV-2 (confirmed customer impact). Post-incident actions: root cause analysis, communication cadence, runbook update.

raj-support: drafted initial customer message template, cc'ing success team. will request legal review for enterprise notices.

ingrid-sre: handoff checklist for next shift: monitor BGP, watch API 5xx, review provider-3 updates, prepare to remove prepends once provider confirms stable. owners: kevin-net (network RCA), sasha (ops timeline), raj-support (customer comms).

nina-product: thanks — keep me updated if we need to pause feature rollouts or adjust SLAs for affected tenants.

sasha (oncall): final note pre-handoff: next oncall is ingrid in 20m. leaving live channel for follow-ups. will reopen if we see more instability. :thumbsup:
